Subject: Prodigy Labs — GPU embargo & sizing verification for final contract

Hi Olivia —

Great to be moving into contract week. To finalize the Dedicated capacity terms we need to confirm internal availability and place a short soft-embargo on the nodes that will back your Dedicated cluster while legal finalizes the SOW.

Quick summary of the ask (from the sizing call last week):
- Dedicated cluster: 12x A100 80GB (inference-heavy), 8x T4 (staging + CI).
- Required start window: 2029-07-01 to support POC run and staged rollout.
- Requested hold duration: 90 days (soft hold, refundable if deal falls through).

Attached is the capacity worksheet we used during sizing (prodigy_capacity_matrix.xlsx). Please confirm the start window and whether the 90-day soft hold is acceptable to you from a contracting perspective.

Internal, looping in Logan and Ben to run a quick availability check and to place a provisional embargo (soft hold) while legal and finance finalize terms. If there's a capacity shortfall we'll propose a fallback mix and the impact on SLAs/cost.

Next steps:
1) Olivia confirm start window and soft-hold acceptance (cc legal).
2) Ops to verify inventory & propose fallback plan within 24 business hours.
3) I’ll prepare the DocuSign order and link to the HubSpot deal (DL-2029-084) once embargo placed.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Olivia —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick clarifying Qs before we lock things in:
- Priority: Is Prodigy the same priority tier as the AtlasAI commit that starts 2029-07-10? If so, we need to map nodes carefully.
- Start tolerance: do you have flexibility +/- 7 days on the July 1 start? That helps scheduling rolling maintenance.

Operational notes:
- I’ll run the fleet availability check now and validate node mappings. We should be able to place a 60-day soft embargo immediately and extend to 90 days if finance/legal provide an MSA signature. The embargo semantics we use are: soft-hold = reservation with rollback window; hard-hold = capacity fenced and billed.
- If we can’t satisfy 12x A100 80GB contiguous, we can propose 8x A100 80GB + 8x A40 (inference quantized) plus an autoscale burst to hosted for peak traffic. I’ll include the perf delta estimate.

I’ll post the snapshot in 2 hours. @Ben — please prepare the node mapping/cost delta table and confirm any competing commitments.

—Logan

Head of Infrastructure Operations
logan_wright@redwood.com

Folks —

Inventory snapshot (as of 2029-05-14 12:30 PDT):
- A100 80GB (available unallocated): 14 GPUs across 5 nodes.
- A40 48GB (available): 16 GPUs across 6 nodes.
- T4 (for staging): 22 GPUs across mixed r3 nodes.

Mapping for Prodigy sizing:
- Preferred: 12x A100 80GB -> 4 nodes (3 GPUs per node), contiguous in us-west-2 cluster.
- Alternative fallback: 8x A100 80GB + 8x A40; performance modeling shows ~12–18% tail-latency increase on 512-token runs for the mixed cluster versus all-A100. We can compensate via prefix caching and conservative batching.

Recommendations & actions:
1) Place a 60-day soft embargo on the 4 nodes identified (node IDs attached in node_mapping_snapshot.csv). This will not bill the customer but marks the hardware as reserved.
2) If a signed PO/MSA is received within those 60 days, convert to a 90-day soft embargo leading up to the hard-fence date and send finance to apply committed billing.
3) If another higher-priority committed deal materializes (e.g., AtlasAI), we will surface tradeoffs and provide a migration plan or temporary hosted-burst.

Attachments: node_mapping_snapshot.csv, embargo_request_form.pdf

Please confirm and I will instruct provisioning to mark the soft-embargo. If approved, I’ll open a change ticket and notify capacity planning.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Planning Lead
ben_carter@redwood.com

Olivia / Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Ben's inventory snapshot we are able to place the soft embargo. Marissa confirming the plan below so legal/finance have the chain of custody for the request.

What we did:
- 60-day soft embargo placed on 4 nodes in us-west-2 that cover the preferred 12x A100 80GB mapping. (This is a reservation flag only; no billing starts.)
- Embargo ID: EMB-2029-05-14-PRD-0091

Conditions for conversion to a hard-fence:
- Prodigy signs the MSA/PO (DocuSign link included) and confirms start date (we are holding July 1 as requested).
- Finance will issue the bill schedule once hard-fence is triggered; soft embargo is non-billable.

Fallback & mitigation:
- If AtlasAI or another higher-priority committed customer needs the nodes, we will provide a mitigation plan (temporary hosted-burst + mixed-A40 fallback). We’ll notify Prodigy 7 days ahead if any manual reallocation is necessary.

Next steps (action items):
- Olivia: sign the DocuSign order and confirm PO cadence (weekly invoicing or net-30). Link: https://app.docusign.com/Prodigy-Dedicated-Order
- Logistics: Ben to attach node mapping CSV to the HubSpot deal and open change ticket CHG-5492.
- Marissa: will update HubSpot and set a calendar hold for the kickoff week (2029-07-01).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this live.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
